name: mirage
text:
"Streaming Lite is $39/mo" (my last message showed it as "9/mo" by mistake, and the blank message after it was a glitch).

Yes, the websocket is a good upgrade. I would not bother with the webhook.

- **Websocket (worth it):** PropLine pushes each line move to the engine as it happens. Today the engine polls, so PropLine quotes are a median 5 minutes old, and with push they would be seconds old. That helps the fair lines most on props, where PropLine is our main source. Pushes are free against the daily cap and Lite includes 2 sockets, one more than the engine needs.
- **Webhook (skip):** it needs a public web address to receive POSTs, and a GitHub runner has none. The websocket gives the same events.
- **Limits:** the websocket only keeps 30 minutes of events for catching up after a drop, so the engine still re-reads the full board now and then. PropLine says it is not a play-by-play feed, so it does not help the live lane. The engine has no websocket client for it yet, so the upgrade only pays off once I build one.

If you buy Lite, send the new key and I will build the client (task PS1). The payoff comes from that client plus the SharpAPI and BoltOdds savings I listed earlier.
